applies_why: The judge text decides UNDERDETERMINED because the text does not name whose body is the channel.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: The phrase never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED: I weighed whether a verse's silence about the channel may support UNDERDETERMINED, or whether such silence cannot be a ground at all.
why: The judge expressly grounds UNDERDETERMINED on the text not naming whose body is the channel, which is the forbidden use of a verse not stating the link.
